hypothesis: Nonlinear interactions between aligned user/item latent coordinates may correct systematic errors that scalar similarity features and previous linear context corrections missed.
validation: Train on first-per-user Thursday queries using pre-Thursday factors; test the pre-Friday frozen first-future-query cohort. Secondary Saturday model trains Thursday+Friday; Sunday model trains Thursday+Friday+Saturday. Full model uses all4 causal first-query cohorts Thursday-Sunday. All daily coordinates aligned to pre-Thursday catalog by label-free orthogonal Procrustes.
models: Paired LightGBM binary offset models, one with scalar factor/uncertainty/history/count/context features, the other adding32 raw aligned user/item coordinates and128 preference/exposure outer products. Fixed init logits from mean-utility11way factor softmax; predict treated-minus-control residual logit contrast.
screen: Primary >=.00005, firstday and delayed positive, third nonnegative and logloss nonworse. Select before secondary; both weekend dates and combined positive.
limits: Reused V142 proxies; delta transfer from paired auxiliary heads, not exact V142 end-to-end validation. Forecast factor training size and dates differ from production.
